runner.script:
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=out.parents[2];base=root/'build/validation/protocol-wrap-2026-10-26/3-isolated';source=base/'src';phase=sys.argv[1]
platform='windows' if sys.platform=='win32' else 'linux';build=base/(platform+'-build')
command=[sys.executable,str(source/'tools/with-artifacts.py'),'--',sys.executable,str(source/'tools/build.py'),
 '--build-dir',str(build),'--config','Release' if platform=='windows' else 'Debug','--jobs','4',
 '--sdl',str(root/('third_party/SDL3-3.2.30' if platform=='windows' else 'build/dependencies/SDL3-linux-3.2.30')),'--test-display']
if platform=='linux':command+=['--sanitizers']
for pattern in sys.argv[2:] or ['explorer_a']:command+=['--test-filter',pattern]
environment=dict(os.environ,ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1')
wm=None
with (out/(phase+'-'+platform+'.log')).open('xb') as log:
 try:
  if platform=='linux':
   environment.update(SDL_VIDEODRIVER='x11',LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE='1')
   wm=subprocess.Popen(['openbox','--sm-disable'],env=environment,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   ready=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(source/'tools/wait-window-manager.py')],cwd=source,env=environment,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   if ready.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Window manager readiness failed')
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=source,env=environment,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 finally:
  if wm:
   wm.terminate()
   try:wm.wait(timeout=5)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:wm.kill();wm.wait()
with (out/(phase+'-'+platform+'.json')).open('x',encoding='utf8') as stream:
 app=build/'bin'/('physim.exe' if platform=='windows' else 'physim')
 json.dump(dict(command=command,exit_code=result.returncode,app_sha256=hashlib.sha256(app.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),stream,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(dict(phase=phase,platform=platform,exit_code=result.returncode)));raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
